newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Kohl, Kinkel to visit Dutch EU presidency.
newsitem.headline: Kohl, Kinkel to visit Dutch EU presidency.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel will visit the Netherlands next Thursday (March 13) for talks with Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok and Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, the Dutch government information service (RVD) said on Thursday.
A spokeswoman told Reuters there was no firm agenda for the talks, but the leaders would focus on current issues coming under the Netherlands' presidency of the European Union.
These would include the inter-governmental conference (IGC), EU and NATO enlargement, the planned single currency and key foreign policy themes, such as the crisis in Albania, she said.
A news conference was planned for 1800 GMT, after the meeting, the RVD said.
